content:
Here is the recipe JSON:
{
  "recipe_name": "Paneer Tikka",
  "ingredients": [
    "250 grams paneer",
    "1/2 cup plain yogurt",
    "1 tablespoon lemon juice",
    "1 teaspoon garam masala",
    "1 teaspoon cumin powder",
    "1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper",
    "1/2 teaspoon salt",
    "1/4 teaspoon black pepper",
    "2 tablespoons butter",
    "2 tablespoons chopped cilantro",
    "2 cloves garlic, minced",
    "1 tablespoon ginger paste",
    "10-12 bamboo skewers"
  ],
  "steps": [
    {
      "step_number": 1,
      "instruction": "Cut the paneer into small cubes and set aside",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Make sure to pat the paneer dry with a paper towel before cutting"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 2,
      "instruction": "In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin powder, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Adjust the amount of spices according to your taste"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 3,
      "instruction": "Add the paneer cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat",
      "time": "10 minutes",
      "tip": "Make sure the paneer is fully coated with the marinade"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 4,
      "instruction": "Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes",
      "time": "30 minutes",
      "tip": "The longer you marinate, the better the flavor will be"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 5,
      "instruction": "Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "You can also use a conventional oven at 400\u00b0F (200\u00b0C) for 15-20 minutes"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 6,
      "instruction": "Thread the marinated paneer cubes onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a little space between each cube",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Brush the skewers with butter before grilling for extra flavor"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 7,
      "instruction": "Grill the paneer tikka for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until it's golden brown and slightly charred",
      "time": "8-10 minutes",
      "tip": "Brush the paneer with butter during the last minute of grilling"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 8,
      "instruction": "Serve the paneer tikka hot, garnished with cilantro, garlic, and ginger paste",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "You can serve it with a side of mint chutney or naan bread"
    }
  ]
}
